title: Venture Capital Associate
description: As a core member of a nascent venture capital fund, I partnered with the founding team to lay the groundwork for a firm targeting AI, blockchain, and crypto startups. My role blended strategic operations, investor engagement, and market intelligence to help build fund infrastructure from the ground up.
bullets: Co-developed investment theses and supported operational strategy for fund formation.
Created pitch decks, refined positioning, and prepared due diligence materials for LPs.
Managed internal research systems and assessed startup market landscapes.
Represented the firm at industry events to deepen market insights.
Completed VC Lab’s 14-week accelerator focused on fund structuring and investor relations.

title: Market Strategy Intern
description: At Kobil Inc., I conducted market research to guide strategic decision-making and designed a mobile application targeted at the education sector. My contributions supported the company’s expansion efforts in new digital verticals.
bullets: Identified market gaps and strategic opportunities through detailed research.
Created a mobile app concept tailored to educational institutions.

title: Data Analyst & Database Manager
description: As a Data Analyst for UCSD's Alumni and Development departments, I built and managed large-scale data systems and predictive models to enhance alumni engagement efforts, contributing directly to improved operational efficiency and outreach targeting.
bullets: Developed machine learning models to predict alumni engagement behaviors.
Built automated Excel tools and custom formulas for streamlined analysis.
Maintained databases with over 1,000,000 records, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.

title: Consultant Intern
description: At Lumnus Consulting, I collaborated with clients to improve organizational efficiency through strategic recommendations and facilitated community-building events to enhance interdepartmental communication.
bullets: Formulated strategy recommendations that optimized internal processes.
Planned and executed engagement events to promote team collaboration.

title: Product Evangelist
description: As a co-founder of Coveritas, I spearheaded outreach to academic institutions and led branding efforts. My responsibilities spanned from direct customer engagement to the design and deployment of our digital presence.
bullets: Directed outreach to schools and universities to promote early adoption.
Designed the company logo and built the website to establish brand identity.

title: Speaker of the Council
company: UC San Diego Seventh College Student Council
description: I served as the Council’s lead policymaker and parliamentarian, authoring foundational documents that formalized council operations and governance. My leadership ensured legislative clarity and operational continuity during a period of structural evolution.
bullets: Chaired meetings and coordinated policy reviews with the Rules Committee.
Drafted the Standing Orders that standardized council procedures.

title: ASB President & SDMC Process Group Member
description: As ASB President, I guided student governance and worked with school leadership to improve student life. Through the SDMC, I co-led initiatives that addressed school-wide academic and community priorities.
bullets: Elected ASB President and served as the student representative in leadership decisions.
Helped implement policies aimed at increasing student engagement and satisfaction.
